name: OmaBroadcast
author: Gavin Nugent
description: OmaBroadcast in the bar: show or hide its window, start and stop recording and streaming, and see at a glance that it is live. Installed by OmaBroadcast; turn it off in its Settings.

barWidget.description: Click to show or hide the window, right-click for recording and streaming. Red while on air.
